description: A pigeon carrying something from one Dream of the Earth player to a mutual. Kept in the sender's repo; the recipient finds it by the backlink index (its 'to'), only from a mutual, and it arrives when a pigeon flying 1,000 km/h would have covered the distance from where it set off. Each recipient takes a pigeon's gift once (their inventory keeps which). After a lunar month it has flown off and the sender's game clears it away.

count.description: How many (at most what fits in a pouch).

fromLatE6.description: Where it set off: the sender's creature (never the player's own location).

note.description: A few words to go with it.
